turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on can?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Sure.

We use **can** to talk about ability, and **can't** when we are not able. After can/can't we use the base verb (no -s, no to).
Example: I can cook. I can't sing.

Exercise: Complete the sentence:
"I ___ ride a bike. I never learned."
